arguments.description: Correzione della vista unificata capacita: esecuzione con privilegi dell invocante, senza dipendere dai privilegi temporanei del ruolo migratore disabilitato.
arguments.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW public.autsys_capabilities_unified WITH (security_invoker=true) AS
SELECT
    'ROBERTA_PLUGIN'::text AS source_kind,
    capability_public_id::text AS source_public_id,
    plugin_key::text AS provider_key,
    capability_key::text AS capability_key,
    capability_type::text AS capability_type,
    capability_description::text AS capability_description,
    capability_level::text AS capability_level,
    NULL::text AS access_mode,
    is_enabled::boolean AS is_enabled,
    requires_approval::boolean AS requires_approval,
    risk_level::text AS risk_level,
    policy_json::jsonb AS policy_json,
    metadata_json::jsonb AS metadata_json
FROM public.plugin_capabilities_server
UNION ALL
SELECT
    'EXTERNAL'::text,
    public_id::text,
    provider_key,
    capability_key,
    capability_type,
    capability_description,
    capability_level,
    access_mode,
    is_enabled,
    requires_approval,
    risk_level,
    policy_json,
    metadata_json
FROM public.autsys_external_capabilities_registry;
